description: The three real Ethernet II frames of the TCP 3-way handshake opening the same `curl https://www.google.com` connection — the TRACE exemplar's packet cards. The flags byte (TCP offset 13) reads 0x02 (SYN), 0x12 (SYN+ACK), 0x10 (ACK).

provenance.captured_with: tcpdump -i eth0 -c40 'tcp port 443' inside docker (ubuntu:24.04, --cap-add=NET_RAW), driven by `curl -s https://www.google.com`
provenance.cross_checked_against: tshark 4.x: frame 1 tcp.flags=0x0002 (SYN), frame 2 tcp.flags=0x0012 (SYN+ACK), frame 3 tcp.flags=0x0010 (ACK); the ack=seq+1 invariant holds (SYN-ACK ack 2651855669 = SYN seq_raw 2651855668 + 1).
provenance.honesty_note: Real bytes off the wire; the flag decode and the canonical SYN→SYN+ACK→ACK order are the dissector's output + the RFC 9293 state machine, not an answer key.

rfc_field_truth.bit_order: CWR ECE URG ACK PSH RST SYN FIN (RFC 9293 §3.1, high bit first)
